My dear [Miss Gatty](/person/469),
The Signora [Linda Villari](/person/1444) wife to [Professor Villari](/person/2345) at Florence sent me this pretty little sketch of a real favourite bird. It is too youthful for the [Packet](/periodical/52), but I think you will like to open a connection with her, as she writes prettily and freshly. I enclose a card she sent with her address. She wrote a very pretty story once for the Packet called the Angel of Viareggio.
I hope you can give a tolerable account of [Mrs Ewing](/person/494). We were greatly charmed with Laetus Sorte Meâ[^3]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
On second thought I will keep the card as if rejected you had better return Dinderino to me
